claims.assertion: Yazhi says Federation rescue would reinforce human dependence; lasting change must arise through human maturation.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says 3D and 5D realities mutually influence; 3D can constrain Federation action more than 5D can shape Earth.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Her model treats realities as perception agreements.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says most 5D cultures use tailored holographic societies grounded in unity and lack of money.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says these societies remain imperfect.
